full_judgment:
41. The appellate Court as a final Court of facts illegally revised the findings of the trial Court ignoring the oral evidence of the parties and arrived at wrong finding without considering the facts and circumstances of the case and, as such, the judgment of reversal is not sustainable in law. 

 50. Turning to the judgment of reversal as passed by the appellate Court below, it appears that the learned Additional District Judge has not followed the same procedure as has been done by the trial Court and more so, without arriving at any independent findings of his own, the appellate Court merely reversed the findings of the trial Court without considering, assessing or evaluating the deposition of the witnesses. The appellate Court has failed to assign any reasoning of his own upon evidence on record, in reversing the findings and decision of the trial Court. In such view of the matter, we find merit in this revision which must be succeeded.
